item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I love that this 001 gives answers. So many SCP's are full of [REDACTED] and [DATA EXPUNGED] and leave it up to your imagination to fill in the blanks, which I get- there's fear of the unknown and our minds will come up with more horrifying things on their own. But when binging SCP's, it gets old after a while having everything mysterious and blanked out. It's refreshing and fun to have one that has a nice reveal at the end and wraps everything up in a neat package for you. It's very satisfying, +1.

item.content:encoded:
This story, while maybe not the best on the site, has really inspired me and shown a very interesting use of the Documents format. The 05's creating a file on something that may or may not be an anomaly, and the following investigation was all very interesting to read, and it leaves a nice air of mystery despite some of the answers towards the end.

Even if some of the dialogue could be considered out of character, I believe that it flows naturally and shows the 05 council as a group of coworkers that actually together and know each other outside of the meeting room. definitely a +1 for me.

This is generally really good, but;

Exploration: Aerial photographs of the area surrounding Site-01-P shown that it had been completely decimated. Almost none of the original structure was intact.

This is not at all the meaning of the word "decimated".

In other news… I'm pretty sure this is an actually explained 001, isn't it? There is no secret, there is not even an anomaly, there's just a room full of extremely paranoid people getting the wrong impression entirely and creating an enormous conspiracy around it. For that alone, +1.

item.title: Oh god no
item.content:encoded:
"Fucking unmutable reminders…"

"One of you bastards thought I would actually drink this."

"That pain-in-the-ass can be patient."

"You’ve all gone soft. It used to be ”if it don’t make sense, throw it in a cage”. Now it's “let’s measure it, look into it, figure out what we know, then make sure it doesn’t bother anyone”. That’s not containment. That’s sitting idly and hoping the public doesn’t find it. My god, we’ve started outsourcing to pet shelters!"

"Like, goddamn it anomalies are essentially running this organization. Ten’s learned how to do magic from the library. I need to take a whole cocktail of drugs just to remember Eight exists."

"He’s the only normal person on this whole fucking Council. We plucked him off the streets, and just started asking him “do you think this is weird?” I’m not worried about someone whose movements we’ve been able to monitor since he came out of the uterus. You fuckers— I don’t know what you all did before you showed up here. For all I know you’re just eldritch abominations waiting for the chance to kill me dead."

"Aside from containing you, like the inhuman aberrations you are."

DAAAAANG I LOVE THIS GUY

+ show block
– hide block

I always see the 05 Council as some inhuman demigods with heck tons of anomalous protection, seemingly untouchable and no longer have semblance to human emotions. They're monster that controls this cruel Foundation, terrifying people, some of the worst power abuser in the most powerful organization.

This article, this [EXPLETIVE] article turn that upside down.

I don't wanna say this but I start to be fond of the Council, and that's not good for me.

But it would be a lie if I didn't say that I didn't love this 001 proposal to very personal level.

I still find the "Scarlet King" proposal to be the most epic, and "When Day Breaks" to be the most beautifully artistic and poetic written SCP entry on the entire site… But this one, buy my heart. Really didn't expect that any of the 001 entries would be amusing and comical, but this is a pleasant surprise.

+1 and added to my favorite SCP page!


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn

item.content:encoded: The writing here is really great, but what stands out to me is the insight into the nature of the 05's. It seems likely (inevitable) that people who had the most responsibility would take rather extreme steps to enhance their ability to function. It's also pretty obvious now that I read this entry that a seat on the 05 council or leverage over an 05 would be an seriously high priority for any a major competitors/enemies/frenemies. Between those, I can see 05-1 suspecting (perhaps correctly) that the Council was terminally compromised and that it needed to rebuilt from the ground up with a verifiably non-anomalous 05 at the core. Just brilliant work all-around, thank you for sharing this!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Logging in for the first time in years just to comment on this. I believe I can safely say this is now one of my favourite 001 proposals.

There is some top notch character writing here. The first transcript sort of rubbed me the wrong way, due to the tone the O5 had while talking among themselves. I think we all felt that "since when do the O5 speak like normal chumps".

And then I realized, of course they do, of course these O5 sound like normal people. They are younger and less experienced, and above all more human than the previous ones. In the last transcript, everyone but One (who was already too unstable to actually sound like a reasonable person) are the super serious, no-joke, filled animosity assholes we have grown to expect from the most powerful people in the planet.

What at first felt as the largest weakness of the article ended up turning back as thematically resonant. Of course the O5 sound like normal white-collar workers. They should, to not become like the ones that came before them. And we can refer to that section when Seven had trouble to communicate and was called "Dumb bitch". Sure sounds childish when compared to the mental image of the O5 we have, but being that open and then formally apologizing in turn after an explanation? That is what people do. I can bet you the more jaded and insane former council would just have remained quiet, made some dry remark and then spend several years digging each other's private information for dirt.

Maybe O5-1, in his madness, did the right thing. Maybe the Council just needed fresh blood.

Overall I think this is pretty good, though I have one major problem and one major problem with the story:

The major problem is keeping all of the O5 council together at one location. This seems like a "putting all your eggs in one basket" situation the Foundation would try to avoid. It seems like the only reason they'd do something like that would be so that in some sort of [_]K-scenario emergency that they could immediately get together a quorum to discuss things that were too sensitive to discuss over secured channels, and I don't know if the utility of that would outweigh the risk of keeping all your eggs in one basket.

I don't know your level of experience in a workplace, but I've worked in 'whitecollar' business for 3 years and people absolutely talk like this. Remember hoverboards a few years ago? I had a boss who rode one around the office and who I talked about Star Wars and Marvel movies with. To be uptight and serious at all times is absolutely absurd and to expect everyone, especially at the top levels of something, to do this is nonsense.

Even in a serious setting, people are people.

Now put people being people in a setting where they're dealing with all the esoteric anomalies of the universe. I'd buy one of them knowing magic. I'd buy one of them being a walking infohazard. When you deal with weird shit you become weirder still, and given how weird people already are I definitely see this as a plausible conversation which could have taken place.

Also a bit of a side note, but if you consider this 'wacky seinfeld shenanigans' i think you completely missed some core themes of the article.
